description: Candid photograph taken in a hallway of the U.S. Capitol/Senate subway-elevator area, marked by lit 'THIS CAR NEXT' signs with arrows. A woman in a white blazer and black trousers, consistent with Sen. Dianne Feinstein, stands with her arm raised against the wall talking to another woman partially hidden behind the wall; several aides and staff in suits stand along the corridor, one man checking his phone. The photo appears to be a candid capture circulated during the 2018 Kavanaugh confirmation period.
text: THIS CAR NEXT. THIS CAR NEXT. THIS CAR NEXT.

Location inferred from 'THIS CAR NEXT' Senate subway signage, not stated in image

description: Candid close-range photograph of Sen. Dianne Feinstein (pale yellow blazer, black trousers) leaning with her arm on the wall while speaking face-to-face with Sen. Lisa Murkowski (black-and-white floral dress, holding a black folder) in a Capitol hallway. The image is the widely circulated September 2018 capture of the two senators in an intense hallway conversation during the Brett Kavanaugh confirmation fight. A red EXIT sign and a small directional wall plaque are visible in the background.
flags: Date/context (September 2018, Kavanaugh vote period) inferred from the photo's known circulation, not shown in image
Small directional wall plaque text not legible

description: Low-resolution CNN Live television screenshot showing Pope John Paul II, in white and gold papal vestments and mitre, embracing or greeting another cleric in gold vestments during an outdoor Mass. A large gray modern cross sculpture stands behind them. The chyron identifies the event as the Pope's visit to the traditional site of the Sermon on the Mount (his March 2000 Holy Land pilgrimage to the Mount of Beatitudes).
text: POPE VISITS HOLY SITE OF. SERMON ON THE MOUNT. CNN LIVE.
flags: Location (Mount of Beatitudes) and March 2000 date inferred from the chyron and known event, not shown on screen

description: Web screenshot of the 1872 painting 'Thor's Fight with the Giants' by Swedish artist Marten Eskil Winge, with a caption crediting Wikimedia Commons. The Norse god Thor, in a red tunic and belt, raises his hammer Mjolnir amid lightning while riding his goat-drawn chariot, battling giants who fall around him.
text: “Thor’s Fight With the Giants”, Mårten Eskil Winge, 1872. (Wikimedia Commons).

description: Meme combining three photographs of filmmaker Spike Lee posing amicably with Donald Trump at social events: a top photo of Lee embracing Trump alongside an unidentified man, and two smaller photos below, one including Melania Trump. Overlaid text rhetorically asks when Lee decided Trump was a 'racist white supremacist', implying his past friendliness contradicts his later criticism; the meme does not date or source the photos.
text: Exactly WHEN did Spike Lee find out that Trump was a racist white supremacist?..... Good question!
